words.ex: Most of Dr Karimova's patients never need a hospital: as a family doctor, she deals with their colds, rashes and check-ups in primary care.
When Laziz's cough hadn't cleared up after a month, his family doctor passed him on to secondary care at the regional hospital in Termez.
The new hospital in Urgench employs more than a hundred physicians, ranging from heart doctors to children's doctors.
Our neighbour is ninety-two and can't manage the stairs, so the doctor makes a home visit once a month.
Dr Saidova is on a training course in Qarshi this week, so a locum from the next town is covering for her and seeing her patients until she gets back.
When Laylo woke up with a sudden, sharp pain in her stomach, the doctor said it was an acute condition and sent her straight to hospital.
Eczema is a chronic condition, so my classmate Shahnoza has to use a special cream on her hands all year round.
If the cream doesn't help, your GP will probably send you to a specialist in skin problems.
After three months of headaches, Kamola was referred to a hospital in Tashkent for some tests.
Since his eyesight started getting worse, Mr Rasulov has his eyes checked by an ophthalmologist every year.
When a routine check showed that his heartbeat was irregular, our PE teacher was sent to a cardiologist.
The dry patches on my elbows wouldn't go away, so I finally made an appointment with a dermatologist.
Every newborn baby in the maternity ward is checked by a paediatrician before going home.
Before my appendix operation, the anaesthetist explained that I would sleep through it and feel no pain.
After a very stressful year at work, Mr Nazarov was referred to a psychiatrist, who helped him to understand and manage his constant worrying.
During her yearly check-up, Mrs Qodirova had an ultrasound scan to make sure that every organ, from her liver to her kidneys, was working properly.
Some people try alternative medicine instead of hospital treatment, but doctors warn that this can be risky for serious illnesses.
The clinic offers massage as complementary medicine, used alongside the treatment patients get from their doctors.
The acupuncturist placed several very thin needles along Mrs Yusupova's shoulders.
After hurting his back lifting boxes, our neighbour Rustam went to a chiropractor, who pressed and moved the joints of his spine.
Instead of ordinary medicine, Mrs Ergasheva's homeopathic doctor prescribed her a small bottle of remedy drops after asking a long list of questions about her sleep, diet and moods.
The aromatherapist added a few drops of lavender oil to the cream before starting the massage.
The regional budget for healthcare in Surkhandarya covers everything from the children's hospital to the dentist and the optician in the main square.
Now that Harry has his first full-time job in Leeds, he is surprised by how much national insurance comes out of his salary each month.
When Ellie broke her wrist on a school trip to York, she was treated on the NHS, so her parents didn't have to pay anything.
If you still feel unwell after a few days, the first person to see is your GP, not a hospital consultant.
Dr Usmonova shares a small surgery near the bus station with two other family doctors.
Twice a year, Shahnoza goes to a special eczema clinic at the children's hospital for a check-up.
When Mr Brown moved from London to Edinburgh, he was pleased that he no longer had to pay a prescription charge for his eye drops.
Nodir's company pays for private healthcare, so he can see a specialist without joining a long waiting list.
The waiting list for a knee operation was six months long, so Mrs Holt decided to go private.
Thanks to the sports club's insurance scheme, treatment for players hurt during matches is paid for.
Once a year, Mrs Rahmonova has a routine check-up with her gynaecologist, who looks after the health of her womb and ovaries.
Throughout her pregnancy, Dilnoza saw the same obstetrician, who was also in the delivery room when her twins were born.
After medical school, Aziza decided to specialise in surgery, because she wanted to spend her working days carrying out operations.
